headline: Mooring County Flares Anew as Weathered Expanse Rages On
war_summary: The map has shifted since our last edition. In Mooring County, where we lately recorded every post beneath the Warden flag, Colonials now hold two of the twelve; forty-nine base actions in a day, MacConmara Barrows busiest at fifteen, have reopened the county question, the latest exchange logged at the hour of this filing, with losses running near 7,900 Colonial against 8,500 Warden. In Linn Mercy, Wardens carried Lathair within the past two hours, the region's only new flag, while casualty rates there leapt to roughly 1,400 Warden and 680 Colonial in the last hour alone. The Weathered Expanse remains the furnace: seventy-one actions in a day, Wightwalk the scene of thirty-one and Frostmarch of twenty-one, the tally standing five Warden, one Colonial, three ruined, with nine thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden down. Stlican Shelf saw eighteen actions about Briar and Breaker Town, yet but one Warden post remains standing there. In Marban Hollow, Checkpoint Bua logged sixteen of eighteen actions, the last at the closing minute. The Nevish Line has raised no flag in twenty-two hours, yet its ledger climbs past 4,600 against 4,400. Day 575 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
